title: Inaccurate records
body: Been using the app for more than 5 years. Used Apple Watch Series 3, series 7 and Ultra 2 for my training records. Noticed that my best records for running were not accurate. Specifically the app showed a badge with time for best running records (5k, 10k & HM). The times shown on the badges were shorter than the actual time recorded. Moreover, after I switched to AW ultra 2. Some of the running records including longest runs went missing. And my best times shown on the badges were close to world records.

title: Remove Segments from Ultra action button
body:
I mean the natural usability rule could not be simpler - either DON’T assign anything to the control that user does not expects to behave differently or if you do then you MUST provide a configurability for what you’ve assigned to it.

But not only that you’ve assigned some freaking Segments feature that I have 0 usage for, but you’ve also made it impossible to get rid of! 👏
Now every time I do pushups or any exercise where my wrist is twisted - my watch constantly vibrates creating those damn “segments”! Who ever thought users need this hardly doing anything besides light jogging with their watch. This is extremely annoying during tough exercises.
